listeningQuestions.audio: Donating books can help children who have none.
opts: 捐书能帮助没有书的孩子。

listeningQuestions.audio: She enjoys volunteering at the nursing home.
opts: 她喜欢在养老院做志愿者。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thank you for helping with the charity sale.
Helping others makes us feel happy.
opts: 帮助别人让我们感到快乐。

listeningQuestions.audio: They raised a lot of money for sick children.
opts: 他们为生病的孩子筹了很多钱。

listeningQuestions.audio: A small act of kindness can warm a cold day.
opts: 小小的善举能温暖寒冷的一天。

quizQuestions.q: ____ others is a rewarding thing to do.
She enjoys ____ at the animal shelter.
Thank you for ____ us with the charity sale.
Donating to charity ____ many lives every year.

quizQuestions.audio: Many teenagers start their own charities.
opts: 许多青少年创办自己的慈善组织。

reading.passage: During the school's charity week, students collected warm coats for children in cold villages. In just three days, they gathered over two hundred coats. The head teacher said it was the kindest thing the school had ever done.
reading.passageCn: 在学校的慈善周,学生们为寒冷山村的孩子收集保暖外套;短短三天就收集了两百多件;校长说这是学校做过的最善良的事。

questions.q: How many coats did they gather?

writing.prompt: Write a short story (about 100 words) about a time you helped someone or did a kind deed.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇约100词的小故事,讲述你帮助他人或做好事的一次经历。

lines.text: Our class wants to do something kind this week.
lines.cn: 我们班这周想做点善事。

lines.text: How about visiting the nursing home?
lines.cn: 去养老院看望老人怎么样?

lines.text: Great idea! The elderly love having visitors.
lines.cn: 好主意!老人们喜欢有人来看望。

lines.text: I'm really looking forward to helping them.
These cakes look delicious! How much are they?
lines.cn: 这些蛋糕看着真好吃!多少钱?

lines.text: Five yuan each. All the money goes to sick children.
lines.cn: 每个五元,所有钱都捐给生病的孩子。

lines.text: Thank you for supporting our charity sale!
lines.cn: 谢谢你支持我们的义卖!
